prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one crisp high-fidelity raster design review board, landscape 4:3, target 2000×1500. This is a flat exported interface specimen, not a photo. All specification measurements describe px-equivalent proportions; no numerical dimension annotations should appear in the board.

## 고정 조건

- **치수**: [profiles.ts](../../../apps/storybook/src/mockups/flex/profiles.ts)가 정본이다. 아래 표는 그 파일에서 생성했다. 이미지에 숫자 주석은 넣지 않는다.
- **브랜드**: 기존 B 보드와 같은 dg-studio 블루 #155EEF로 고정한다. 비교 조건을 맞추기 위한 고정이며 브랜드 결정이 아니다. 브랜드 비교는 Storybook Brand 툴바에서 한다.
- **중성색·의미색**: DDS 0.8.0 기본 semantic 값(아래 표). 근사 hex를 쓰지 않는다.
- **타이포**: 시스템 산세리프(한글 양호), regular 400 / bold 700 두 굵기만. 본문 14px, 보조 13px, 캡션 12px, 제목 20~24px 상당. 모바일 본문 16px 상당.
- **포커스**: 입력류는 테두리 1px + 안쪽 1px(바깥 링 없음). 비입력 컨트롤은 2px 링 + 2px 간격.
- **부유 패널**: 흰 표면 + 1px stroke-neutral-weak 경계 + overlay 그림자. 다크에서도 경계가 보여야 한다. 기본 목록·카드에는 그림자를 쓰지 않는다.
- **아이콘**: 단일 stroke SVG 스타일. 문자 기호·이모지를 조작 아이콘으로 쓰지 않는다. 도메인 표식(코드 배지·아바타)은 B 보드에서만 값 이해용 슬롯으로 허용한다.
- **문구**: 주어진 한국어 그대로, 짧은 합쇼체. 가상 데이터.
- **금지**: 초록 주 행동, 그라데이션, 유리·3D·원근, 기기 목업 프레임(모바일은 390px 폭 화면 영역만), 장식 차트, 거대한 아이콘, 모든 구역을 카드로 감싸기.
- **캔버스**: 가로 4:3(목표 2000×1500). 좌상단 작은 "dg-design / flex study", 큰 보드 제목, 부제 "A · 앞선 적용안" 또는 "B · 원문 우선 재검토". 하단 작은 "Design proposal · 2026".

### DDS semantic 색 (studio 블루 브랜드)

| 역할 | 라이트 | 다크 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bg-layer-default (표면) | #FFFFFF | #0F1212 |
| bg-neutral-weak (약한 표면·hover) | #F1F6F6 | #242727 |
| bg-neutral-weak-hover | #E4E9E8 | #3A3E3E |
| fg-neutral (본문) | #242727 | #F1F6F6 |
| fg-neutral-weak (보조) | #6B706F | #AEB2B2 |
| stroke-neutral (입력 테두리) | #6B706F | #898D8D |
| stroke-neutral-weak (구분선·패널 경계) | #E4E9E8 | #3A3E3E |
| bg-disabled / fg-disabled | #E4E9E8 / #898D8D | #3A3E3E / #6B706F |
| bg-brand-solid / hover | #155EEF / #175CD3 | #5298FF / #70A6FF |
| bg-brand-weak | #EFF4FF | #0B254A |
| fg-brand | #0D4AC4 | #84B9FF |
| fg-brand-contrast | #FFFFFF | #0F1212 |
| stroke-focus-ring | #2B7FFF | #5298FF |
| critical fg / solid / stroke / weak | #731115 / #9B1C22 / #C7272D / #FCF3F2 | #F0C9C5 / #EF958E / #F04646 / #4B090B |
| positive fg / weak | #0F4A17 / #E7FCE7 | #83F289 / #06300B |
| overlay 딤 | rgb(15 18 18 / 0.5) | 같음 |
| overlay 그림자 | 0 12px 32px rgba(15,15,15,.18), 0 4px 8px rgba(15,15,15,.08) | 같음 |


VARIANT A ONLY — translate these into visual px-equivalent proportions at a consistent screenshot scale. Never print measurements or design-token names on the artwork. Each pair below means desktop, then mobile. Use the appropriate member for the UI specimen.
Page horizontal insets about 32px on desktop and 20px on mobile.
Gaps between related fields about 12px and 14px. Gaps between groups about 24px and 28px.
Work-panel inner padding about 40px and 20px.
Field and select trigger heights about 40px and 56px; corners gently rounded about 6px and 16px; inner horizontal padding about 12px and 16px; value text about 14px and 16px.
Medium button corners about 8px and 12px. Main CTA heights about 48px and 52px.
Select popup corners about 14px in both contexts; popup padding about 8px in both; options at least 36px high on desktop and 48px on mobile with about 6px corners. Multiple-selection square marks about 16px.
Menu popup corners about 12px and padding about 6px in both contexts; menu items at least 36px on desktop and 48px on mobile, with about 6px corners.
Sheet inward-facing corners about 16px on desktop and distinctly rounded 24px on mobile; padding about 24px and 20px.
Two-line list rows about 64px high in both contexts; one-line list rows about 56px high in both; horizontal row padding about 16px; leading-to-main gap about 12px.
Chip heights about 28px on desktop and 32px on mobile; corners about 8px in both.
No extra setting-row height or radius is prescribed for variant A.
Tabs at least about 40px high, horizontal padding about 12px, tab-to-panel gap about 24px in both contexts.
Table rows about 44px high in both contexts.
Body typography about 14px with 19px line height on desktop; about 16px with 24px line height on mobile.
Shared component proportions: ordinary buttons about 36px, 40px, or 52px high. Checkboxes either about 16px square with 4px corners, or 20px square with 6px corners. Switches about 32×20px or 40×24px. Floating panels have a visible 1px boundary. Confirmation Dialog has about 16px corners and 24px padding.

VARIANT CHARACTER
A · 앞선 적용안: 현재 DDS에서 출발해 역할 토큰을 연결한다. 외부 라벨 outline 입력이 기본, 반경을 조금 둥글게 올린 세트(6/8/12/14/16px 상당). Select는 field 트리거가 기본이고 버튼·칩 트리거는 후속 확장. Radio는 브랜드 원형 유지. List·Chip·PropertyField는 검토 후보. 모바일 Sheet 모서리는 24px 상당.
Render only variant A, with exact subtitle "A · 앞선 적용안". No variant B content. All control icons are thin consistent stroke outlines; no emoji, no letter or initial avatars, no code emblems. Match actual DDS controls: restrained thin outline fields, round-corner weak fill chips, thin neutral popup boundaries, clear separate active/focus/error states. Use system sans-serif Hangul, regular 400 and bold 700 only, not the fallback serif font seen in raw test captures. Do not print specification paragraphs, hex codes, pixel values, component token names, or explanations about this prompt. Exact Korean strings below must be rendered cleanly. Do not add unrelated filler. Board has a small top-left "dg-design / flex study", a clear large title, the exact variant subtitle, and small bottom-left "Design proposal · 2026".

BOARD 11 — 신규 구성요소
Title: "신규 구성요소". Light-theme white artboard. Spacious, strongly aligned design-system composition: upper left is List, upper right is Chip, lower left is desktop PropertyField, lower right is a narrow mobile PropertyField sample. Use headings and whitespace with hairline separators, not a grid of cards. These three components are review candidates, shown with a small plain caption "검토 후보" once under the board subtitle.

UPPER LEFT: heading "List" and a real SectionHeader row reading "발행 목록" with count "3" and a small text action "전체 보기". Show three full-width rows. First is a one-line row about 56px tall: a small stroke document icon as leading, "10월 업데이트" as main text, a trailing weak badge "초안", a separate thin chevron row-opening affordance and a distinct three-dot menu button at the far end. Second is a two-line row about 64px tall: a stroke document icon; primary line "디자인 시스템 안내", secondary line "김민지 · 10월 12일"; trailing weak badge "발행됨", separate row-open chevron and end menu. Third is another two-line row: document icon; "프로젝트 회고", secondary "이도윤 · 10월 14일"; trailing "검토 중", separate chevron and end menu. Neutral hover surface on the second row. A small label below the list reading "행 열기와 더보기" makes the two distinct actions clear. No avatars or initial badges. Natural trailing layout, crisp separators, no shadows on the list.

UPPER RIGHT: heading "Chip". Three vertically stacked unboxed specimen groups with labels "제거형", "필터 토글형", "필터 툴박스".
Under "제거형": two compact rounded neutral chips "디자인" and "개발", each with its own small stroke close icon; height about 28px with 8px corners.
Under "필터 토글형": chips "전체" selected blue weak fill with small stroke check, "초안" and "발행됨" unselected neutral.
Under "필터 툴박스": a compact toolbar with active chips "디자인" and "이번 달", each removable; visible result label "결과 12개" at left and "초기화" reset action at right. All controls distinct and readable.

LOWER LEFT: heading "PropertyField · 데스크톱". Three clean inline horizontal property rows using an aligned label column and inline values, not boxed form fields: "상태" → weak text badge "초안"; "담당자" → "김민지" with a small stroke chevron; "발행일" → "2026. 10. 12." with a small stroke calendar. Each has label and value on the same baseline, restrained separators and 56px-equivalent row spacing. Desktop text about 14px. No domain avatars.

LOWER RIGHT: heading "PropertyField · 모바일". A plain rectangular screen-region crop at 390px-equivalent width, no device frame. Show mobile property rows about 56px tall, 20px page inset, label left and value plus chevron right: "상태" / "초안", "담당자" / "김민지", "발행일" / "10월 12일". Body about 16px. This is a row-format non-keyboard value selection sample. Keep no decorative illustration. Balance all four sections so every row, remove action, filter toggle, result count, reset, and mobile-versus-desktop property field is visible.
notes: Earlier worker original, superseded by v2. All required content present; chips and badges were pill-like, and original status badges used unsupported yellow and green.
